archived_cut_policy: September cached summaries remain fixed; cut/block variants change current campaign chains only and retain identical archived anchors. They do not certify archive warmup.
scope: Reuse audited September scout/refinement archives. Replacements prefer later longer pooled starts at identical coordinates. Cached2000draws preserve xi/m2 covariance across derived eta/R quantities. Targets eta=.25 and xi/L=.7506912 are infinite-size limits; finite-box crossings are not yet extrapolated BKT estimates. Weighted monotone interpolation uses the nearest finite-bootstrap anchors at least3MCSD away fromtarget, falling back to adjacentknots if unavailable. This expands too-tight existing neighborhoods to preserve root tails, without requiring remote undefined massive-phase ratios. Data-selected window margins and monotonicity are declared sensitivity choices, not calibrated coverage. No Binder used as phase criterion, no old files modified.
